text: Hey all, quick question: are there any specific volunteer projects the company supports, or can we pick anything local? Trying to plan something for next month.

Hey Elena! There are a few projects the team’s been involved with recently—Operation Warm, Fontanus Research Center, National Charity League, and Hack for She come to mind. I think you can also do something local, but those are some examples from the handbook if you want inspo. Check the GiveLab Volunteer Initiatives section for more details!
Awesome, thanks Sam! I’ll take a look at that section. Operation Warm sounds interesting, actually.
